title: 2.5 Adaptation and Mitigation Strategies to Climate Change
description: UNFCCC response strategies, adaptation types, Ethiopian practices and mitigation measures. Hard level.

questions.question: Why must mitigation and adaptation be pursued together?
options: It eases impacts but does not limit the underlying climate change
Adaptation that takes place after initial impacts have occurred
They address different parts of the problem: causes and impacts
It adjusts farming practice to cope with changed water availability
questions.correctAnswer: They address different parts of the problem: causes and impacts

questions.question: How does irrigation illustrate adaptation?
options: It adjusts farming practice to cope with changed water availability
Adaptation that takes place after initial impacts have occurred
Sensitivity to the issue grew after the IPCC Third Assessment Report
Whether it is motivated by households and companies or by government
questions.correctAnswer: It adjusts farming practice to cope with changed water availability

questions.question: Why is natural-system adaptation described as reactive?
options: Reduce greenhouse gas emissions and enhance sinks
Alleviate the adverse impacts of climate change
Species respond after conditions have changed
Replacing coal power with wind energy
questions.correctAnswer: Species respond after conditions have changed

questions.question: What does enhancing sinks mean in practice?
options: Adaptation that takes place before impacts become apparent
Cutting fossil fuel use for electricity, heat and transport
Protecting forests, soils and oceans that store carbon
To moderate potential damages or benefit from opportunities
questions.correctAnswer: Protecting forests, soils and oceans that store carbon

questions.question: How would you classify a government building-code reform?
options: Planned, public adaptation
Mitigation and adaptation
Crop diversification
Changing crop planting date

questions.question: Which strategy reduces the long-term magnitude of warming?
options: Soil conservation
Water harvesting
Terracing
Mitigation

questions.question: What is an example of reducing emission sources?
options: Cutting fossil fuel use for electricity, heat and transport
Adaptation that takes place after initial impacts have occurred
Adaptation that takes place before impacts become apparent
They address different parts of the problem: causes and impacts
questions.correctAnswer: Cutting fossil fuel use for electricity, heat and transport

questions.question: What limitation of adaptation alone explains the need for mitigation?
options: Sensitivity to the issue grew after the IPCC Third Assessment Report
It adjusts farming practice to cope with changed water availability
It eases impacts but does not limit the underlying climate change
Whether it is motivated by households and companies or by government
questions.correctAnswer: It eases impacts but does not limit the underlying climate change

questions.question: How do mitigation and adaptation differ in timing of benefit?
options: Systems that accumulate and store greenhouse gases, such as forests and oceans
Changes systems undergo in response to climate regardless of any policy or plan
Mitigation lowers future warming while adaptation lowers current impacts
Mitigation reduces future warming; adaptation reduces current impacts
questions.correctAnswer: Mitigation reduces future warming; adaptation reduces current impacts

questions.question: Which Ethiopian practice reduces soil erosion while adapting to climate change?
options: Soil conservation
Terracing
Water harvesting
Mitigation
